gen-gf-revalia-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Loud, loose and a bit theatrical, Revalia stretches its letters across the line with a relaxed stride. But Chocolate Classical Sans does the quieter work, with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-comme: Expressive Revalia strides loosely, its letters set well apart. Revalia is best given big, short lines, while Comme handles the rest with a smooth read and curves that never clog.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-gafata: Revalia comes in loud, with a relaxed stride and an open-curved g. Gafata does the steadier work beneath it, with wide-eyed lowercase e's, while Revalia saves its swagger for the biggest type.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-geist: Bold Revalia swaggers across the line, tall and loosely spaced. Geist holds a level, quiet beat paragraph after paragraph, with no accents of weight, its words settling into solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara reads with a fixed stroke thickness and generous gaps. Next to it, Revalia feels louder and more theatrical, a relaxed stride and open-looped g against all that tidy, spacious restraint.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-huninn: Huninn rises close to cap height, with s terminals held clear. Revalia is the one to look at, loose-strided and expressive, while Huninn is the one to read, its crossbars as fat as its stems.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-kufam: Contemporary Kufam runs on one track width, like a neon tube. Revalia brings the swagger with its relaxed stride and open-curved g, and Kufam keeps each stroke uniform and its curves generous underneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro skims along at a gentle, unchanging stroke weight. Revalia is built to be seen, loose in stride, while Maven Pro is built to be read, high-waisted and welcoming.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline reads big-bodied and approachable, with a splayed c terminal. Revalia adds expressive, widely spaced swagger up top, then hands off to Mozilla Headline, which stays contemporary down in the text.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mozilla-text: Tall bodies make the lowercase look bold, and the terminals flare outward. Mozilla Text is the sturdy one here, giving Revalia's loose, expressive swagger something firm to stand beside.
